title: SPRI Beads Preparation Protocol
author: Daniel Kitsberg
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bes2jege

substeps.instruction: Weigh 12.5 g of PEG 8000 into a sterile 50 ml tube.
Add no more than 14 mL of DDW.
Rotate for approximately one hour until the PEG is dissolved and the solution is homogeneous.
Bring the total volume to 25 ml.
Rotate for an additional 10 minutes until a homogeneous solution is attained.

steps.title: Prepare 50 ml RNA Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare RNA Wash Buffer (1 mM Trisodium citrate, 0.05% Tween 20, pH 6.4 @ 25 °C).

substeps.instruction: Add 30 mL nuclease free water to a container.
Add 50 µL 1M Trisodium citrate.
Add 250 µL 10% Tween 20.
Add 21 µL 1N HCl.
Complete the volume to 50 mL with nuclease free water.

steps.title: Wash Sera-Mag Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the Sera-Mag beads using the prepared RNA wash buffer.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the Sera-Mag beads thoroughly.
Transfer 1 mL of beads to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Magnetize the tube and discard the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of RNA wash buffer.
Remove the tube from the magnet and resuspend the beads by vortexing for at least 15 seconds.
Spin down with a microcentrifuge, magnetize, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the addition of buffer, vortexing, and supernatant removal twice more for a total of 3 washes.
Leave the supernatant in the tube after the final wash.

steps.title: Prepare 50 mL SPRI Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare SPRI Buffer (1mM Trisodium citrate, 2.5 M NaCl, 20% PEG 8000, 0.05% Tween 20, pH 6.4 @ 25 °C).

substeps.instruction: In a 50 mL conical tube, mix the base buffer: 4.672 mL nuclease-free water, 25 mL 5M NaCl, 28 µL 1N HCl, and 50 µL 1M Trisodium citrate.
Remove the supernatant from the washed beads, add 1 mL of this base buffer to the bead tube, and resuspend by vortexing for 15 seconds.
Briefly spin down the liquid without pelleting the beads.
Add the washed beads to the base buffer in the 50 ml tube.
Cap and vortex for 30 seconds.
Slowly dispense 20 mL of 50% PEG stock, allowing the viscous liquid to slide down the inside walls of the pipette.
Add 250 µL 10% Tween 20.
Cap the tube and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Store and Verify SPRI Buffer
steps.instruction: Store the prepared SPRI Buffer and verify quality before use.

substeps.instruction: Store at 4 °C for at least two weeks.
Verify pH before use.
